basic_profile.bio: A 35-year-old based in Seattle, WA, I've been on a journey of self-improvement for over a decade. Currently working as a software developer, I have a deep passion for storytelling and gaming, which is reflected in my love for 'Sanders Sides' and various tabletop games like 'Arkham Horror LCG'. I'm an avid fan of car modifications and enjoy spending my weekends in my garage working on my latest project. I'm single, but I have a close-knit group of friends who share my enthusiasm for gaming and fandoms. Typically active online in the evenings, I frequently engage with communities that provide both intellectual stimulation and entertainment.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies primarily in software development, which I honed through a combination of a computer science degree and years of hands-on experience in the tech industry. I am also well-versed in fandom culture and gaming strategies, much of which I learned through active participation in online communities and self-study.
